items.title: Add artifact release ledger and non-runtime artifact digest classification
items.context: Create a deterministic append-only record for non-runtime deliverable path sets changed by DONE merges, excluding .lattice lifecycle metadata and watched CLI/runtime inputs.
items.userSees: DONE emits `✓ artifact release recorded: story=B-xxxx commit=<sha> artifactSetDigest=sha256:<digest> paths=<n>` when non-runtime releasable paths exist.

happy.desc: experiments/** changed paths classify as non-runtime releasable artifacts and produce a stable digest.

edge.desc: .lattice story metadata and packages/main runtime inputs do not become non-runtime artifact release rows.

adversarial.desc: mixed runtime plus non-runtime changes keep semver bump semantics separate from artifact ledger records.

verificationEvidence.note: artifact-release-ledger smoke covered docs/** and experiments/** classification plus stable digest generation.
artifact-release-ledger smoke proved .lattice story metadata and packages/main runtime inputs are excluded from release paths.
smokes covered mixed runtime plus non-runtime changes while version-bump smoke preserved the existing semver boundary.

items.title: Expose artifact release inspection commands and DONE post-merge report line
items.context: Add CLI handlers for listing/status inspection and call the ledger from DONE post-merge effects after the story branch merges into main.
items.userSees: `lattice artifact_release_list --format=json` prints records including storyId, mainCommit, artifactSetDigest, runtimeSemverChanged, and paths; `lattice artifact_release_status --storyId=B-xxxx` prints the matching record or `No artifact release records found`.

happy.desc: artifact_release_list returns recent records as JSON/text.

edge.desc: artifact_release_status can filter by story id and clearly reports none when absent.

adversarial.desc: DONE ledger write is idempotent for the same story/commit/digest and does not duplicate rows.

items.title: Document the semver/provenance boundary and validate with smoke coverage
items.context: Update lifecycle documentation to state CLI semver remains runtime-bound and non-runtime DONE artifacts use the artifact release ledger.
items.userSees: Docs say: `CLI patch version remains a runtime/capability marker; non-runtime DONE artifacts are recorded in artifact-releases.jsonl as provenance, not package semver.`

happy.desc: new smoke passes and is wired into validate commands.

edge.desc: existing version-bump smoke still proves experiments do not trigger CLI semver bump.

adversarial.desc: docs state artifact release records are provenance, not runtime activation or package semver.
